title: RAPINOE GETS IN FIRST TIME. BECKHAM TAKES THE SIDE DOOR
description:
Four new names in the National Soccer Hall of Fame, and two very different routes in.

Megan Rapinoe, David Beckham, Jozy Altidore and Julie Ertz are all in.

Rapinoe went in on the player ballot in her first year of eligibility. Two Women's World Cups and the 2019 Ballon d'Or will do that. Altidore, who scored 42 goals for his country, and Ertz came through the same ballot.

Beckham took the veteran ballot instead. Six Premier League titles, and he still used the side door. The ceremony is on 16 April in Plano, Texas, so somebody should check the suit.

Who deserved it most: Rapinoe, Beckham, Altidore or Ertz? Pick one and tell us why.
